reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Strengthening control of Tuberculosis ("TB") and HIV/AIDS in the Republic of Armenia - Armenia (01-Oct-2021-31-Dec-2024)

description.narrative: Armenia, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Armenia (MOH)This program has the following goals: Close the gap in achieving 95-95-95 targets: increase early HIV detection, rapidly scale-up ART and improve quality of care, and reduce HIV incidence. Accelerate progress in fulfilling the UNHLM commitments and achieving targets to end tuberculosis in Armenia. Leverage health and community system resources and ability to sustain effective HIV and TB responses and remove structural barriers impeding key and marginalized populations in accessing HIV and TB services. The objectives of this program are: Increase early HIV detection, scale up ART and improve quality of care. Reduce HIV transmission by expanding coverage of innovative prevention interventions in key populations. Ensure universal access and improve quality of TB and DR-TB detection and diagnosis. Improve treatment outcomes of people with DR-TB. Health system strengthening. Community system strengthening including sustainable mechanisms for public health financing of services delivered by CSOs. Remove human rights and gender barriers and achieve zero discrimination towards people with TB and HIV
